events.subtitle: Guzheng and banjo across Chinese and Appalachian folk traditions
events.factual_description: Wu Fei and Abigail Washburn perform two shows at The Mansion at Strathmore in North Bethesda on Sunday, October 18, 2026, at 4:00 PM and 7:00 PM. Wu Fei's official concert schedule independently confirms the October 18 Strathmore date with Abigail Washburn. The duo brings together Wu Fei's guzheng and vocals with Washburn's banjo and vocals, drawing on Chinese folk traditions and Appalachian old-time music. Their October run also includes a World Music Institute performance at DROM in New York on October 17, establishing that the Strathmore engagement is part of an active regional tour rather than a one-off appearance.

en.why_it_matters: This is not generic 'world music' crossover. Guzheng and clawhammer banjo come from very different tuning systems, attacks and folk lineages, yet Wu Fei and Abigail Washburn have spent years making the two instruments behave like close conversational partners rather than symbols placed side by side. The Mansion is an especially good scale for hearing the plucked-string detail, bends, rhythmic friction and the way their voices move between Chinese and Appalachian material without an ensemble hiding the joins.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the two Mansion sets if the local calendar is open. It is a particularly strong DMV opportunity for instrumental identity and cross-cultural listening, while the duo's New York performance the night before and broader October run mean there is no need to displace a genuinely singular premiere, farewell or one-off elsewhere in the corridor.

es.why_it_matters: Esto no es un cruce genérico de 'world music'. El guzheng y el banjo clawhammer vienen de afinaciones, ataques y tradiciones populares muy distintas, pero Wu Fei y Abigail Washburn llevan años haciendo que los dos instrumentos conversen de verdad en vez de colocarlos juntos como símbolos. The Mansion tiene una escala especialmente buena para escuchar el detalle de las cuerdas pulsadas, los bends, la fricción rítmica y la manera en que sus voces pasan entre material chino y apalachiano sin que un ensamble grande esconda las costuras.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los dos sets en The Mansion si el calendario local está abierto. Es una oportunidad especialmente fuerte en el DMV para escuchar identidad instrumental y diálogo cultural; como el dúo toca en Nueva York la noche anterior y lleva una corrida de varias ciudades en octubre, todavía dejaría precedencia a un estreno, despedida o one-off verdaderamente singular en otro punto del corredor.
